recent_articles.title: Ahead of kharif season, Dharwad Deputy Commissioner warns traders of strict action ‘creating artificial scarcity’ - The Hindu

recent_articles.title: Kevin Warsh takes over US Fed with a policy problem already in view - The Economic Times
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The Federal Reserve's new chair, **Jerome Powell**, faces a challenging task as he navigates the complex economic landscape.  **Christopher Waller**, a Fed Governor who has recently shifted his stance on monetary policy, is advocating for a possible rate hike to combat rising inflation. recent_articles.title: BSE 100 rejig: Paytm, Ashok Leyland and CG Power enter index; Adani Group-owned Ambuja, 2 more exit - The Economic Times

recent_articles.title: KERC directs Escoms to give consumers 15 clear days to pay bills - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **The Karnataka Electricity Regulatory Commission (KERC)** has mandated that all electricity distribution companies provide consumers with a minimum of 15 days to pay their bills from the actual bill issuance date, not the scheduled billing date. The commission emphasized that late or extended billing cycles do not exempt Escoms from providing consumers with sufficient payment time.

recent_articles.title: Govt reduces petrol by Rs6 per litre, high-speed diesel by Rs6.8 - Pakistan - DAWN.COM

This is the second consecutive week of fuel price reductions, following a series of adjustments made in response to global market fluctuations and the ongoing US-Israeli war on Iran. The government has been adjusting petroleum prices weekly since the conflict began, aiming to mitigate its impact on consumers while balancing budgetary considerations.

recent_articles.title: NTPC Green Energy Q4 Results: Cons PAT declines 15% YoY to Rs 197 crore despite 47% revenue uptick - The Economic Times
recent_articles.rephrased_article: Despite a 47% revenue growth to Rs 913 crore in Q4FY26, **the state-run company** saw its profit fall to Rs 247 crore from Rs 307 crore in the same period last year. recent_articles.title: Kevin Warsh sworn in as new US Fed chair | Business and Economy News | Al Jazeera
recent_articles.sentiment_target: United States Federal Reserve Board of Governors

Warsh's appointment comes amid political pressure on the historically non-partisan institution and a contentious nomination process.  He will lead the central bank at a time when inflation is rising, with consumer prices increasing 0.6 percent in April and energy prices surging.  The first policy meeting Warsh will lead is scheduled for June 16-17.

recent_articles.title: Sebi bars seven entities in social media stock recommendations, alleges Rs 58 crore gains - The Economic Times
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Sebi**, India's market regulator, has accused seven individuals and a group of entities, including Rohan Gupta and Sharon Gupta, of manipulating stock prices through social media influence. recent_articles.title: Deepa Jewellers, Cotec Healthcare receive Sebi approval for IPOs - The Economic Times

recent_articles.title: LTM to acquire Randstad’s tech, consulting businesses for €160 million - The Hindu

recent_articles.title: Estée Lauder ends merger talks with Gaultier owner Puig | Retail industry | The Guardian

recent_articles.title: Arvind Panagariya’s advice to RBI: ‘100 is just a number; let rupee depreciate or reserves will bleed out’ - The Economic Times

recent_articles.title: Oil prices rise as investors doubt breakthrough in US-Iran peace talks - Business - DAWN.COM

recent_articles.title: Markets to enter prolonged “drag phase,” not deep correction: Vikas Khemani - The Economic Times

recent_articles.title: Focus on infrastructure, agricultural productivity, developing clusters for export: U.P. State Transformation Commission CEO - The Hindu

recent_articles.title: Rupee moves up after 10 days on likely RBI intervention - The Economic Times

recent_articles.title: Cigarette business weakness drags ITC margins in March quarter - The Economic Times

Prime Minister **Keir Starmer** and Chancellor **Rachel Reeves** stated the initiative aims to ease pressure on household budgets while supporting struggling businesses.

recent_articles.title: Govt reopens offshore oil frontier - Business - DAWN.COM

recent_articles.rephrased_article: **LIC**, the State-owned insurance company, announced a 1:1 share swap for existing shareholders. The company reported strong Q4 earnings with a 23% year-on-year increase in consolidated net profit to Rs 23,467 crore. **LIC's** board recommended a final dividend of Rs 10 per share for the financial year 2025-26.  The company also saw significant growth in its net premium income, VNB, and assets under management (AUM).

recent_articles.title: Honasa Consumer Q4 results: Profit more than doubles to Rs 69 cr; co declares Rs 3 dividend - The Economic Times
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Honasa Consumer**, the parent company of **Mamaearth**, reported its highest-ever quarterly revenue of Rs 682 crore in Q4 FY26, driven by strong growth across key categories and a robust offline distribution network. The company's EBITDA reached Rs 77 crore, marking its highest-ever quarterly operating profit.  **Honasa Consumer** also announced a maiden final dividend of Rs 3 per equity share, representing 51.2% of FY26 standalone profit after tax. Chairman and CEO **Varun Alagh** attributed the company's success to investments in AI-led content systems, research and development, product innovation, and distribution infrastructure.

recent_articles.title: Sebi proposes changes to pre-open listing session of IPOs for better price discovery - The Economic Times
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Sebi**, the Securities and Exchange Board of India, has released a consultation paper seeking public feedback on proposed changes to the Call Auction Session framework used for relisted stocks. The regulator cited concerns that the current system, which uses dummy price bands and base price calculations, is leading to artificial price suppression and persistent buying pressure once trading begins. **Sebi** wants to understand if these mechanisms need modification to improve efficiency and reduce distortions in price discovery.  The consultation paper outlines how equilibrium prices are determined during the pre-open session for IPOs and relisted stocks.

recent_articles.title: Boo of Jobs: Real anger about Artificial Intelligence at US convocations - The Times of India
recent_articles.rephrased_article: Across the United States, commencement speakers who mention **artificial intelligence** are facing backlash from graduates and communities concerned about job displacement and the uneven distribution of benefits from the AI boom.  At several universities, graduates booed speakers who discussed the future of **AI**, expressing frustration over potential job losses and concerns about the impact of data centers on their communities. While proponents of **AI** highlight its potential for economic growth and innovation, critics argue that the gains are not evenly distributed and raise questions about democratic consent in the face of rapid technological change.  This growing public skepticism towards **AI** reflects a broader societal concern over the impact of technology on employment and social equity.

recent_articles.title: Over 15 MF schemes cut exposure to these 10 stocks in April ’26. Do you own any? - Stock Ideas | The Economic Times
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Mutual funds** significantly reduced their holdings in 14 stocks during April 2026, a trend driven by geopolitical uncertainties and market volatility.  The analysis revealed that nearly 15 stocks saw a decrease in mutual fund exposure compared to March 2026. Notably, seven of these stocks have experienced negative returns so far in CY26, with some declines exceeding 60%.

recent_articles.title: Select SFBs and MFI players positioned for earnings upside: Rajiv Mehta - The Economic Times
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Rajiv Mehta**, from **Yes Securities**, stated that while the NBFC sector faces external risks, underlying credit performance has remained stable. He highlighted microfinance and select housing finance players as attractive sub-segments within the broader financial space.  He noted strong collections in lending categories, but cautioned that macro risks remain a key monitorable. Mehta believes the strongest cyclical recovery is unfolding in microfinance and microfinance-linked small finance banks, citing renewed growth momentum in affordable housing companies. He also recommended focusing on select lenders with large microfinance portfolios, such as **Ujjivan**, **CreditAccess Grameen**, and **Fusion**.  While acknowledging a positive credit cycle, Mehta cautioned that macro uncertainties could delay the pace of improvement due to inflation and affordability stress.

recent_articles.title: GE Vernova T&D emerges as top BSE Power multibagger with 164% returns; should investors buy now? - The Economic Times
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **GE Vernova T&D India** shares have surged following strong Q4FY26 earnings, reporting an 89% year-on-year jump in net profit and a 42% revenue increase. The company's robust operational momentum is attributed to factors like improved margins and healthy order inflows. Analysts at **HDFC Securities** and **PL Capital** have revised their EPS estimates upwards, maintaining a "Buy" rating on the stock with target prices of Rs 5,200 and Rs 4,650 respectively.  Despite this positive outlook, some analysts are concerned about the recent share price rally and have downgraded the stock to "Accumulate".

recent_articles.title: Ola Electric shares can crash up to 35%, warns Emkay after seeing Q4 results - The Economic Times
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Ola Electric**, led by **Bhavish Aggarwal**, reported a consolidated net loss of Rs 500 crore for the January-March quarter of the financial year 2026, down 42.5% from the previous year.  While the company saw some sequential volume improvement and market share gains, **Emkay** analysts believe Ola's recovery will be a long process due to competition from incumbents like Ather Energy and TVS Motor Company. The brokerage firm maintains its 'Sell' call for **Ola Electric Mobility** shares but raised its target price to Rs 25 from Rs 20.

recent_articles.title: Apollo Micro Systems shares rally 22% in 3 days after strong Q4 results. Should you buy? - The Economic Times
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Apollo Micro Systems** shares surged nearly 6% to a new 52-week high on Thursday, driven by strong quarterly and annual financial performance. The defense player reported a 163% year-on-year increase in net profit for the fourth quarter of FY26, alongside a significant rise in revenue.  The company attributed its success to acquisitions, licensing agreements, and record order bookings. Analysts predict continued upward momentum for the stock, recommending fresh buying with a stop loss at Rs 340.

recent_articles.title: Jubilant Foodworks shares crash 8% after Domino's India operator's Q4 results. What spooked investors? - The Economic Times
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Jubilant FoodWorks**, the operator of Domino's Pizza, reported a 66% year-on-year increase in net profit for the January-March quarter of the financial year 2026. Revenue from operations grew 19% YoY to Rs 2,499 crore during the quarter. The company recommended a dividend of Rs 1.2 per share (60%) with a face value of Rs 2 each for the financial year that ended on March 31, 2026, subject to shareholder approval at the upcoming AGM. Despite temporary LPG supply constraints impacting operations, **Jubilant FoodWorks** managed the situation effectively and expects normalized supply in Q1FY27.  Analysts from various brokerage firms have varying opinions on the company's performance, with some maintaining a "Buy" rating while others express concerns about near-term margin pressures.

recent_articles.title: Mega merger incoming: Should you buy PFC, REC shares ahead of merger? Here's what analysts say - The Economic Times
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Nirmala Sitharaman**, the **Union Finance Minister**, announced plans to restructure **Power Finance Corporation (PFC)** and **Rural Electrification Corporation (REC)** for streamlined operations. The Cabinet Committee on Economic Affairs approved a proposal where PFC acquired 52.63% of the government's holding in REC, consolidating them into a single balance sheet.  Analysts suggest investors consider staggered exposure to PFC and REC as the merger process is subject to regulatory approvals and structural adjustments. While PFC offers better visibility due to its parent status, REC presents a merger-arbitrage opportunity with higher event risk depending on the swap ratio.

recent_articles.title: Ketan Parekh Case: Sebi sends show cause notice to 6 Capital Group FPIs - The Economic Times
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Sebi** has initiated legal proceedings against **Capital Group**, alleging that its traders, James Vincent Cheng and Terence Tsai, leaked sensitive information about impending trades to Salgaocar, who then shared it with Ketan Parekh for front-running the market. The regulator claims that this resulted in illicit gains for those involved.  The investigation covers a period from January 1, 2021, to June 20, 2023, and Sebi alleges that **Capital Group** failed to maintain confidentiality regarding its trading intentions.

recent_articles.title: Reeves to promise free summer bus rides for children and food tariff cuts in living costs package | Economics | The Guardian
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Rachel Reeves**, the chancellor, will announce a package of measures to address rising inflation caused by the Iran conflict. These include free bus rides for children aged 15 and under during August as part of the "Great British summer savings scheme" and the removal of tariffs on certain food imports. The Treasury estimates the cost of these measures at £400 million, with details about funding to be outlined on Thursday. **Keir Starmer** has also announced postponements to fuel duty increases and a vehicle tax holiday for lorry drivers.

recent_articles.title: RBI proposes rules to let lenders disable phones for loan defaults - The Economic Times
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **The Reserve Bank of India (RBI)** has proposed amendments to its Responsible Business Conduct Directions that would allow banks to restrict functionalities of borrowers' mobile devices only under tightly regulated conditions. The draft guidelines, effective from October 1, 2026, specify that restrictions can be imposed only after a loan becomes 90 days past due and following multiple notices to the borrower.  The RBI has also introduced stricter rules for loan recovery, including mandatory certification for recovery agents, public disclosure of empanelled agencies, and prohibitions on assigning cases while grievances remain unresolved. The draft norms also prohibit banks from accessing or storing data on borrowers' phones and impose restrictions on recovery staff conduct.

recent_articles.title: Sensex gains 560 points, Nifty above 23,800. Key factors behind today's Dalal Street rally - The Economic Times
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The **Sensex** and **Nifty 50** gained significantly on Thursday, driven by a combination of factors including cooled bond yields, declining oil prices, and hopes for an Iran-US peace deal.  The **Rupee** strengthened against the US dollar, while global markets rallied as some vessels resumed passage through the Strait of Hormuz. However, foreign investors remained net sellers in Indian equities, raising concerns about sustained market strength.

recent_articles.title: Australia’s unemployment rate jumps to 4.5% in ‘tentative signs labour market is buckling’ | Unemployment | The Guardian
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Australia’s** unemployment rate surged to 4.5% in April, marking the highest level in nearly four-and-a-half years, according to the **Australian Bureau of Statistics**. The unexpected decline in employed individuals contributed to this increase, prompting economists to question whether the **Reserve Bank of Australia** will raise interest rates again.  The jobless rate remains below pre-pandemic levels but has been on an upward trajectory since late 2022, and financial markets are now factoring in a smaller chance of future interest rate hikes.

recent_articles.title: Lenskart shares rise 2% after Q4 profit slips; revenue jumps 46% YoY - The Economic Times
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Lenskart**, despite a profit decline, reported strong operational growth in FY26. Revenue increased 32% to Rs 9,002 crore, driven by a 46% year-on-year rise in revenue from operations to Rs 2,516 crore.  The company conducted 23.8 million eye tests globally, with India experiencing strong same-store sales growth (SSSG) and expanding its footprint to 157 new cities. International operations also performed well, with international revenue growing 30% and EBITDA margin improving to 7%.

recent_articles.title: IMF wraps up Pakistan visit following talks with authorities on reforms, budget - Business - DAWN.COM
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The **International Monetary Fund (IMF)** mission concluded talks with **Pakistan** authorities, focusing on economic developments, fiscal plans for the next financial year, and progress on reforms under its IMF-supported programs. The mission, led by **Iva Petrova**, discussed disruptions from the Middle East conflict, budget formulation, and ongoing reform efforts in areas like energy, state-owned enterprises, and financial sector reforms.  The authorities reaffirmed their commitment to a primary surplus target of two percent of GDP and emphasized efforts to broaden the tax base and improve fiscal management. The IMF mission also highlighted the importance of maintaining an appropriately tight monetary policy stance and building a deeper foreign exchange market.  Discussions on structural reforms and progress under the Resilience and Sustainability Facility (RSF) were also covered, with the next mission expected in the second half of 2026.

recent_articles.title: Samsung strike on hold as workers push for AI bonus
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Samsung Electronics** reached a tentative pay agreement with its largest union, averting a planned strike that could have disrupted the global technology industry. The deal will be voted on by union members from May 22nd to 27th and includes bonuses for memory chip workers at least six times higher than those received by employees in other units. **Samsung** had proposed bonuses of 607% of annual salary for memory chip workers, while other employees would receive only 50% to 100%. The company's stock price rose after the agreement was reached, and the South Korean court granted an injunction to prevent a strike from disrupting operations.

recent_articles.title: Fed Minutes: More officials warned of rate hike scenario - The Economic Times
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Many** officials at the **Federal Open Market Committee** meeting last month expressed concerns about persistent inflation, prompting a debate over whether to signal an interest-rate increase.  The minutes of the April 28-29 meeting show that while some participants believed rate cuts would eventually be warranted, most favored firming up policy if inflation remained above 2%. The decision to retain the easing bias in the post-meeting statement was a closer call than at the previous meeting and could potentially be revisited.  Incoming Fed Chair **Kevin Warsh** will face this challenge as he takes over from outgoing Chair Jerome Powell.

recent_articles.title: Parle Industries hits upper circuit amid ‘Melody’ confusion - The Economic Times
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Parle Industries** shares surged 5% on Wednesday after a social media video showed **Prime Minister Narendra Modi** giving a 'Melody' toffee to his Italian counterpart, **Giorgia Meloni**. The stock's trading volume spiked significantly, exceeding its two-week average. This is not an isolated incident; similar mix-ups have occurred in the past with companies like LG Electronics India and Tata Motors, highlighting the potential for confusion among retail investors during market volatility.

recent_articles.title: Manchester shows biggest fall in inner-city deprivation in boost for Burnham | Economics | The Guardian
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Manchester** has experienced the largest decline in inner-city deprivation among UK towns and cities, according to a report by **the Centre for Cities**.  Between 2010 and 2025, **Manchester** saw a 17 percentage point fall in deprivation rates, exceeding other major cities like **London** and **Liverpool**. This success is attributed to the city's devolved powers and interventionist economic policies championed by **Andy Burnham**, who is vying for leadership of the **Labour Party**.

recent_articles.title: Long-term SIPs deliver consistent gains as market volatility eases over time - The Economic Times
recent_articles.rephrased_article: A study by **Whiteoak Capital** found that SIP returns diverged in shorter holding periods, narrowing over longer durations.  For a three-year horizon, returns ranged from 55.6% gains to 24.6% losses, but for investments of eight years or more, all SIPs made gains and did not experience losses. **Madhu Nair**, CEO of **Union Mutual Fund**, recommends a minimum investment period of 10 years to benefit from rupee cost averaging and navigate market cycles.

recent_articles.title: Why CEA Anantha Nageswaran says India is facing a ‘Live Balance of Payments Stress Test’ - The Economic Times
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **India** is facing a significant strain on its balance of payments (BoP) due to rising global crude oil prices and geopolitical tensions. The country's heavy reliance on imported energy has led to a surge in import costs, widening the current account deficit and weakening the rupee. Economists warn that this situation mirrors past crises like the 1991 balance of payments crisis and could require long-term adjustments.  **HSBC** suggests India needs to attract sustainable capital inflows while reducing its current account deficit. **India's** economic stability hinges on managing these challenges effectively, particularly in the face of global shifts impacting trade, capital flows, and energy security.

recent_articles.title: Bound for Mars, Elon Musk's SpaceX unveils filing for blockbuster IPO - The Economic Times
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **SpaceX**, the world's largest space business, is poised to become the first trillion-dollar U.S. market debut and could set a precedent for other monumental IPOs in the coming months. The company's planned listing on the Nasdaq under the ticker symbol 'SPCX' could value it at $1.75 trillion, making its founder, **Elon Musk**, the first trillionaire in history.  The sale would cement SpaceX as one of the world's most valuable publicly traded companies and solidify its position as a leader in space exploration with plans for lunar and Mars missions and expansion of its Starlink satellite internet business.

recent_articles.title: India needs to raise R&D spending to 2 pc of GDP by 2035 to boost manufacturing: Report - The Economic Times
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Careedge Ratings** released a report highlighting India's manufacturing sector challenges.  The report states that India's R&D spending is only 0.6-0.7% of GDP, significantly lower than global peers like the US (3%), China (2.5%), and South Korea (up to 5%). This low investment hinders growth in value-added production, contributing to a decline in manufacturing's share of GDP from 16% in 2015 to 13% in 2024.  The report recommends increasing R&D spending to 2% by 2035, along with greater private sector participation, stronger innovation ecosystems, and improved research-to-commercialization pipelines.  It also emphasizes the need for strengthening STEM education, deeper industry-academia collaboration, higher private-sector R&D investment, and integrated innovation-led industrial ecosystems to enhance India's global competitiveness.

recent_articles.title: PSX gains 1,900 points, maintaining renewed buying - Business - DAWN.COM
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The **Pakistan Stock Exchange (PSX)** experienced a significant gain of over 1,900 points on Wednesday, closing at 164,831.42 points, driven by investor confidence boosted by easing tensions between **Iran** and the **United States**, along with lower international oil prices.  Heavyweight stocks like **Meezan Bank Limited (MEBL)**, **Fauji Fertiliser Company Limited (FFC)**, and **Pakistan Petroleum Limited (PPL)** contributed significantly to the market's bullish momentum. The positive performance was also supported by increased trading volume of 386 million shares, with **SSGC** leading the way.

recent_articles.title: AI boom: Global stock market order shuffles as Taiwan, South Korea overtake Western giants - The Economic Times
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The **South Korean** Kospi stock market has experienced a significant surge, more than tripling in less than 18 months, surpassing even the Nasdaq's bull run in the 1990s. This rally has propelled South Korea to eighth place globally in equity-market capitalisation rankings, overtaking the UK.  While analysts point to the sustainability of this rally compared to the dotcom bubble, concerns remain about the concentration of capital into a few AI firms, particularly **TSMC** and Samsung Electronics. The surge in Asian markets is also attracting foreign investment, with some analysts suggesting it may be driven by interest in AI and semiconductor themes.

recent_articles.title: US stocks today: Dow soars 600 pts, Nasdaq 1.5% as chip stocks rally eyeing Nvidia results, Iran peace deal hopes - The Economic Times
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The Philadelphia SE Semiconductor index rallied, boosted by optimism surrounding artificial intelligence (AI) despite concerns about the U.S.-Israeli war on Iran and rising inflation. **Nvidia**, the leading AI chipmaker, is expected to release its report later today, which could influence investor sentiment.  While energy prices and inflation remain factors of uncertainty, investors are increasingly focusing on the potential of AI, driving gains in technology stocks like **Astera Labs** and **ARM Holdings**. The S&P 500 gained 1.08%, while the Nasdaq Composite rose 1.54%.

recent_articles.title: RBI to infuse liquidity via $5 billion dollar rupee swap auction on May 26 - The Economic Times
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The **Reserve Bank of India (RBI)** will hold a USD/INR buy/sell swap auction on May 26th to address the recent depreciation of the rupee. The central bank aims to stabilize the currency by selling dollars and boosting forex reserves, which have been depleted due to interventions in the foreign exchange market. This is the first such swap since February 28th, when geopolitical tensions began. Banks will sell dollars to the RBI at a predetermined premium, with successful bids accepted at their quoted rate.

recent_articles.title: Sebi proposes to permit third-party payment in mutual funds in certain scenarios - The Economic Times
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Sebi**, the Indian markets regulator, proposed allowing third-party payments in mutual funds for specific scenarios such as employer-sponsored investments and AMC payment of commissions. The proposals aim to balance ease of investing with investor protection by implementing safeguards like KYC checks and electronic fund trails. **Sebi** seeks public comments on these changes until June 10th.
